With trembling fingers, Arthur uncorked it and unfolded the paper, reading words written in a desperate, unfamiliar hand that spanned decades of silence across the deep, dark ocean.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市，褪去了白日的喧嚣，披上了一层薄薄的晨雾。路灯将行道树的影子拉得修长，偶尔有早起清洁工的扫帚声划破寂静。远处的立交桥上，零星的车灯如流星般划过夜空，留下光轨。高楼大厦的窗户大多陷入沉睡，只有几盏长明灯在夜色中闪烁。空气中带着一丝微凉的露水气息，整座城市仿佛在积蓄力量，等待着第一缕晨光的唤醒。", "w03": "- Recursion is a programming technique where a function calls itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- Every recursive function needs a base case to stop calling itself, preventing it from running forever.\n- Think of it like looking into two facing mirrors, where each reflection gets smaller until it finally fades away."}
